name: Tajín Villarreal
career: Airport operations coordinator at a regional municipal airport
bio: Tajín Villarreal is a genderfluid Mexican American airport operations coordinator who starts the day checking runway conditions, then winds down at night with flight sim sessions, Stevie Ray Vaughan on the speakers, and way too many tabs open about flagship phones and Porsche GT3 specs. On weekends, they bounce between bass fishing with their partner, tinkering on an old Cummins pickup, and chasing their toddler and two chaotic pets—a blue heeler mix and a rescue cat—around the yard. They love Alabama football, gospel music, and comfort-food cookups, but they’re just as likely to pull a tarot card before bed as they are to read a devotional. A surprising side hobby: they make hand-cut wooden bird decoys in the garage and occasionally trade them with duck hunters they know online.
